access: GM_ONLY. Keeper preparation, not a played turn and not a compulsory plot.
binding: Do not decide Shiki's next approach or expose him to the guard post: he is not identified, no alarm has been raised and he is still outside the village.
Late amendment s10.text.129 supersedes the invented checkpoint encounter, wanted poster and any house entry.
Shiki's reputation is in professional Bingo-book and pursuit channels, not public posters and certainly not an omniscient village network.
World events happen autonomously. Shiki only learns by credible sources with time, distance and bias. His player does not control NPCs.
The Suna attack already occurred 12.03 03:00; Shiki only heard an unsourced trade rumor about a missing Kazekage and road restrictions. Never tell him Deidara, Sasori or details until obtained.

Shiki's identifying association with S-17 and personal targeting may be known to some participants from what they directly witnessed; never leak source facts to geographically absent NPC by convenience.
NEW_EVENTS are contingent continuations within existing arcs, not three compulsory episodes; no fixed deaths, no script immunity, no invented obstacle after a correct deduction.

Stale scene.present in the s10.129 handoff must be corrected to nemera only; Reika, Hirano and Matsuda physically remained near the P-4/Seventh Well area. A stale presence-based NEXT.must is not an in-scene fact.

events.trigger: Only when Shiki chooses an approach from the Kusa outskirts, or genuinely waits and world time passes.
events.question: What consequences follow Shiki's actually chosen method of entering, observing, contacting or avoiding his former village?
endings: He crosses/observes without being discovered and gains only what is reachable by that route; hidden events elsewhere continue.
A source-backed observer detects a meaningful trace, not his identity by fiat; response and costs follow the observer's resources.
Shiki chooses not to enter or leaves; the village proceeds without him.
A prior concrete alarm or pursuit mechanism, if evidenced, changes the cost without taking his agency.
events.risk: The village seeks an S-rank fugitive with a 49m ryo bounty, but has neither public wanted posters everywhere nor supernatural detection.

events.trigger: A credible person/document/communication connects the P-4 shutdown and old Kusa evidence to Shiki or an actor Shiki meets.
events.question: Who can preserve, lose or weaponize the established records and medical samples after the documented actions at P-4?
endings: One existing document or witness becomes accessible with an independently checkable provenance and yields only its own knowledge.
A participant retains or hides an important record; a real gap remains.
An independent authority obstructs or reuses an existing channel; the outcome produces an observable political/medical cost.
No new evidence reaches Shiki; offscreen actors record their own choices and costs rather than waiting for him.
events.guard: Do not decide the unknown organizer of personalized attacks by association; do not retroactively restore destroyed P-4 cultures, reverse treatment or assume records of all derivative shipments are complete.

events.trigger: The Suna crisis causes material shifts through established travel/mercenary/communications channels; Shiki is free to ignore it.
events.question: Which verifiable consequences of the already-occurring Kazekage abduction can reach Shiki's world before the ongoing Suna chapter reaches its endpoint?
endings: A second independent source corroborates part of the trade rumor, with travel time and residual uncertainty.
Travel, prices or competing missions change due to risk; the change is visible but not an exposition dump.
The Suna conflict runs without Shiki and produces its own canon-compatible outcome; Shiki remains uninvolved.
The rumor proves partly wrong in secondary details even though the underlying attack occurred.
events.guard: Do not use a headline or narrator aside to hand Shiki the attackers' identities; make world news a material effect of autonomous actors.

carry_next: Apply actual NEXT.must for absent actors as offscreen plans, not dialogue in Kusa. The last scene has Nemera only.
Keep Reika's independent search and direct communication possible, without mandatory contact.
Keep ongoing S-17, family confidentiality, Lower Hospital and old instruction chain separate until source-backed proof connects them.
Reinforce user correction: no invented thinking, words, routes, fear or cooperation by Shiki. Plot and NPC decisions may be cruel or strategic.
Keep genre as intense cosmic/body horror, not bureaucratic procedural; return old details with deeper causal meaning rather than add fresh plot clutter.
